# Lucas Daneluz — Product Manager

> Product Manager with 10+ years of experience across B2B SaaS, FMCG and supply chain. Based in London. Open to PM roles.

Lucas moved into Product from commercial and operational roles in category management, Procurement and supply chain. That background is why he reads a Product decision commercially: what it costs, who has to change what they do, and what would show it worked. He has worked across engineering, finance and operations.

Core strengths: Product discovery, stakeholder alignment, roadmap prioritisation, user research, and working in ambiguity.

## Portfolio & Case Studies

- [Work overview](https://lucasdaneluz.vercel.app/work): All case studies and selected projects
- [Platter — Onboarding Automation](https://lucasdaneluz.vercel.app/case-studies/platter-onboarding): Turned manual supplier data migration into a guided mapping, review and validation workflow. Outcome: internal data mapping reduced from 1–2 weeks to minutes. Tags: B2B SaaS, Data Migration, Workflow Automation.
- [WalkUp — Smarter Queues](https://lucasdaneluz.vercel.app/case-studies/walkup): Rebuilt a waitlist around telling diners the truth about their wait, then gave them a reason to come back. Outcome: 3× loyalty engagement uplift. Tags: Marketplace, Waitlist UX, Loyalty.
- [Hipen Media — User Onboarding](https://lucasdaneluz.vercel.app/case-studies/hipen-media): Found why four different publisher types were all being asked the same twelve questions, then cut the flow to what each one actually needed. Outcome: 40% faster onboarding completion. Tags: Discovery, Onboarding, MVP, B2B SaaS.
- [Westpak — Cost Optimisation](https://lucasdaneluz.vercel.app/case-studies/westpak): Ran a six vendor tender without breaking supply, by letting Operations keep their old suppliers running until the new ones had proved themselves. Outcome: 25% cost reduction. Tags: Stakeholder Management, Cost Optimisation, Supply Chain.
- [Run Your Pace — Personal Build](https://lucasdaneluz.vercel.app/case-studies/run-your-pace): A Couch-to-5K app built because no running app let him scroll through interval timings. Live and used weekly. Tags: Personal Build, React, Side Project.
